Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops fakes: a newcomer posts a 5-credit deposit, locked until behavior earns it back.

The deposit anchors the identity while the agent tends a small garden of tasks over 10 epochs; honest work traces a widening spiral, and only a matching fingerprint lifts the lock. Copies forfeit it.

Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 5 = 5,000 credits and 10,000 epochs of fake behavior; one honest agent pays 5 once.
